gloss: infants and toddlers; babies and small children

definitions.gloss: infants and toddlers; babies and small children
definitions.explanation: A collective term for very young children, typically from birth to around age 5 or 6. Combines {乳児|にゅうじ} (infant, roughly 0-1) and {幼児|ようじ} (toddler, roughly 1-6).

examples.japanese: {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入場無料|にゅうじょうむりょう}です。
examples.english: Infants and toddlers get in free.

examples.japanese: {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: Traveling with young children is tough.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{乳幼児|にゅうようじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{届|とど}かない→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please keep this medicine out of reach of young children.

notes:
{乳幼児|にゅうようじ} is a compound of ⟦{乳児|にゅうじ}→乳児：11414_nyuuji⟧ (nursing infant, roughly 0-1 years old) and ⟦{幼児|ようじ}→幼児：12478_youji⟧ (young child, roughly 1-6 years old). It is commonly used in official, medical, and public contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}⟦{健診|けんしん}→健診：17390_kenshin⟧ (infant health checkup)
- {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}⟦{突然死|とつぜんし}→突然死：20490_totsuzenshi⟧⟦{症候群|しょうこうぐん}→症候群：30368_shoukougun⟧ (sudden infant death syndrome / SIDS)
- {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}{向|む}け (for infants and toddlers)

USAGE:
This word is frequently seen on signs, product labels, and in health-related materials. It is more formal and specific than ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧ or ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧. You will encounter it at hospitals, on medicine packaging, and in public facility rules.
